meta.name: story
meta.description: 网络小说工具箱主入口。根据用户需求自动路由到对应 skill，并可管理作者习惯、启动本地 Dashboard。触发方式：/story、$story、/story dashboard、/网文、「我想写小说」「记住我的写作习惯」「打开工作台」「检查更新」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 打开写作工作台,把灵感、章节和写作习惯集中管理
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把长篇网文的灵感、章节与写作节奏都收进一个工作台打理。
copy.tagline_en: Open your writing workbench and keep ideas, chapters, and habits in one place
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write long-form fiction and want ideas, chapters, and habits handled together

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 变成网文工具箱的入口:按你的需求把请求分发到长篇/短篇写作、拆文、扫榜、审稿、去 AI 味等具体技能;也能记住你的写作习惯、启动本地工作台、检查版本更新。
howto.when: 当你输入 /story、$story 等入口,或说「我想写小说」「记住我的写作习惯」等话时接管;意图不明时给出几个白话选项让你挑。

say.text: 我想写一部长篇,先帮我规划开书和大纲
帮我把这章改得不那么 AI

say.note: 启动本地 Dashboard 并返回地址

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude becomes the entry point of a web-novel toolbox: it routes your request to the matching skill (writing, analysis, rankings, review, de-AI editing), stores author habits, starts a local dashboard, and checks updates.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you type /story, $story or say things like "I want to write a novel" or "open the dashboard"; with no clear intent it offers a few plain options.

say_en.text: I want to write a long serial - help me plan the book and outline
Make this chapter sound less AI-written

say_en.note: Starts the local Dashboard and returns its URL
